summary.en: These are things you keep at home so you can live even if electricity, water and gas stop. Prepare at least 3 days' worth, ideally 7. Guide amounts: about 3 litres of water per person per day (drinking and cooking), and portable toilet bags for 5 to 6 uses per person per day. For food, buy a little more of what you usually eat and replace it as you use it ("rolling stock"). Check expiry dates and batteries from time to time.
